adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb the test "raises an error with a missing host" no longer sets up the old SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts (line removed) and does not stub a referer. In the updated production code (EmbedController#ensure_embeddable) the only guard is `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)`, and when `request.referer` is nil `host_allowed?` returns false (URI(nil) rescued to nil), causing the same failure as the separate "raises an error with no referer" test in the "with a host" context. So this test no longer specifically validates behavior for an empty EmbeddableHost table; it effectively just exercises the no-referer path.
